map: LOC 12th Army Group situation map, 26 Dec 1944

units.result: record [5.62, 50.1]  reader [5.61, 50.07]  3 km  ok  note: Hatched box with XX and 15 just northwest of the Bastogne ring. The number and position fit the 15th Panzer Grenadier Division, but the map does not spell out the unit type beyond the hatched division box.

readerNotes.line: Traced along the heavy ticked line from the top edge, around Aachen and Monschau, the Elsenborn shoulder, southwest past Manhay and Hotton to the west tip of the bulge near the Meuse east of Dinant, back east along the southern side, east along the III Corps front to the Sauer and Moselle, then southeast to the east edge in the Saar. Bastogne is drawn as a separate closed ring around the 101st (centered near 5.71E 50.03N); it is not part of this line and is not included in the points. The unticked army group boundary that meets the line at the tip was not followed. Points are sampled evenly along the line.
